# Network Speaker {{VERSION}}

## Download

- Download `{{PACKAGE_BASENAME}}.msi`
- Optionally verify `{{PACKAGE_BASENAME}}.sha256.txt`

## Install

1. Run the MSI on Windows x64
2. Launch `Network Speaker` from the Start Menu
3. Enter the Android device IPv4 address and UDP port
4. Click `Start`

## First use

- For Android real devices, keep the phone and PC on the same LAN
- For browser audio on Windows, prefer `wasapi-role=multimedia`
- For a quick connectivity test, switch the source to `sine`

## Known limitations

- Windows-only GUI in this release
- No code signing yet, so SmartScreen may show a warning
- No system tray or auto-start in this release
